builds.version: PortMaster package (rolling; retail game version user-supplied)
builds.notes: PortMaster port.json declares aarch64, with launch script/native engine inspected. Bundled native fallout-ce game engine; requires legally purchased Fallout 1 data (critter.dat, master.dat, data folder). Requires PortMaster and applicable native runtime or controller/graphics libraries. NOT tested on Steam Frame; do not assume this package works directly on SteamOS.
